key_insight: High overall accuracy can hide failures to apply the stated rules for missing information.
engineering_relevance: AI agents using incomplete records should be tested on whether missing facts remain unknown or count as false under the applicable completeness rules.
method: Test each base scenario under open-world (OWA), closed-world (CWA), and local closed-world (LCWA) assumptions, changing only how missing information is treated.
Count a base scenario as correct only when all closure variants are answered correctly.
Provide a verified base benchmark and agent extensions for action choice, source scope, and updates.
evidence_signal: Across 960 instances and replicated runs, overall accuracy ranged from 71.18% to 99.86%, while accuracy on scenarios whose gold label changes with the closure rule ranged from 18.23% to 99.31%.
watch_item: Real-world deployment also requires establishing which sources are complete; following a stated closure rule does not establish that the rule is appropriate.
paper_title: ClosureBench: A Benchmark for Reasoning under Closure Assumptions
